units.source_text: 封盘是不让对手和工作人员看见，由轮到的棋手亲自写在棋谱上，然后放进信封里。

en.t: A sealed move is written personally on the game record by the player whose turn it is, without letting the opponent or the staff see it, and is then placed in an envelope.

units.source_text: 上次中途暂停时，大竹七段是走到廊道上写的。

en.t: When the game was suspended midway last time, Otake seventh dan went out into the corridor to write it down.

units.source_text: 对弈者在信封上打了封印，再放在另一个大信封里，由八幡干事加上封印。

en.t: The player sealed the envelope, then placed it inside another large envelope, which Secretary Yahata sealed as well.

units.source_text: 到下次续弈的早晨，这个大信封一直存放在旅馆的保险柜里。

en.t: Until the morning when play resumed, this large envelope was kept the whole time in the inn's safe.

units.source_text: 名人和八幡都不晓得大竹七段的封子。

en.t: Neither the Master nor Yahata knew Otake seventh dan's sealed move.

units.source_text: 但是旁观者猜来猜去，大致上还是可以推测出来。

en.t: But as the spectators guessed back and forth, they could still more or less infer it.

units.source_text: 黑121封子，究竟下在什么地方呢？

en.t: Where, in the end, was Black's sealed move at move 121 played?

units.source_text: 它是这盘棋的高潮，连我们这些观战的，也都紧张得屏声敛息。

en.t: It was the climax of the game, and even those of us watching were so tense that we held our breath.
